core_obligations: Choose representatives (proof lines 23334-23345): take a bounded below complex F^bullet of abelian sheaves representing K; i_*(F^bullet|_Z) represents R i_*(K|_Z) because i_* is exact, and choosing a quasi-isomorphism b_{small}^{-1}F^bullet -> I^bullet into a bounded below complex of injectives gives that b_*(I^bullet) represents R b_*(K|_{X'}), the map being adjoint to the chosen quasi-isomorphism.

Identify the third term (proof lines 23346-23352): pi_*(I^bullet|_E) = (b_*I^bullet)|_Z by the pushforward form of proper base change, and this complex represents R pi_*(K|_E), so the map R i_*(K|_Z) + R b_*(K|_{X'}) -> R c_*(K|_E) is represented by the displayed surjection of bounded below complexes.

Reduce to a stalkwise statement (proof lines 23353-23365): a short exact sequence of complexes gives a distinguished triangle, so it suffices that F^bullet -> i_*(F^bullet|_Z) + b_*(I^bullet) maps quasi-isomorphically onto the kernel of that surjection; this may be checked at geometric points.

Check the two cases (proof lines 23366-23385): outside Z the blow-up is an isomorphism near the point, so the statement reduces to F^bullet_x -> I^bullet_{x'} being a quasi-isomorphism, which holds by the choice of I^bullet; and above Z one has b_*(I^bullet)_x -> i_*((b_*I^bullet)|_Z)_x an isomorphism of complexes, so the kernel is i_*(F^bullet|_Z)_x = F^bullet_x as required.
proof_roadmap: Represent K by a bounded below complex F^bullet and replace the three derived pushforwards by explicit complexes using exactness of i_* and a quasi-isomorphism into injectives for b.
Use proper base change to represent the third term and write down the surjection of complexes.
Prove that F^bullet maps quasi-isomorphically onto its kernel by checking stalks, splitting into points outside Z and points above Z.
difficulty_reason: The lemma produces the cohomological descent distinguished triangle K -> Ri_*(K|_Z) + Rb_*(K|_{X'}) -> Rc_*(K|_E) for the blow-up square of a finite type quasi-coherent ideal and torsion coefficient complexes (statement lines 23314-23331). The proof (proof lines 23333-23385) represents the three derived pushforwards by explicit complexes — using exactness of i_*, an injective resolution for b and proper base change for c — and then verifies the resulting sequence of complexes is short exact by a stalk computation at a geometric point, with the two cases x not in Z (where the blow-up is an isomorphism nearby) and x in Z (where the comparison of complexes is an isomorphism). H2: an explicit choice of representatives followed by a two-case stalk check.
